name: Scroll Reveal
description: Page content fades and slides into place as visitors scroll to it. Native CSS scroll-driven animations with a tiny fallback, and nothing moves for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

panels.title: Scroll reveal
panels.description: How page content appears as visitors scroll. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Reveal content on scroll
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: distance
fields.title: Distance
fields.description: How far content travels on its way in; for zoom in, how much it grows. Fade in does not move.

choices.title: Headings, text, images and cards, one by one

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get the effect. For example: home, contact
